name: Shinpoong Pharmaceutical Co.,Ltd
summary: Shinpoong Pharmaceutical Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and sells pharmaceutical products in South Korea and internationally. The company offers cephalosporin antibiotics, penicillin antibiotics, finished pharmaceutical products, antiviral drugs, anticancer drugs, painkillers, anti-inflammatory products, anthelmintics, and prescription and over-the-counter pharmaceutical products. It also develops and manufactures active pharmaceutical ingredients, anti-malarial drugs including Pyramax, drugs for hypercholesterolemia, knee osteoarthritis, and shoulder periarthritis, as well as surgical adhesion barriers and other medical products.
